select fulldate
from 
    	(
		
			SELECT 
				MAX(OTR.PROCESS_DATE) DEPOSITS_DATE
			FROM 
				OM.OM_TASKS OT 
			INNER JOIN OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
				ON OTR.TASK_NAME=OT.TASK_NAME
			INNER JOIN
				OM.OM_STATUS OS
				ON
				OS.STATUS_ID=OTR.STATUS_ID
				AND OS.STATUS='SUCCESSFUL'
			WHERE  
				OT.SOURCE_CODE = 'DEP'
				AND OT.DATA_LAYER LIKE '%EDS%'
				AND coalesce(OT.BATCH_NO,1) = 2
		) ect
inner join 
    eds.date_dim dd
    on 
    ect.DEPOSITS_DATE=dd.previous_business_day and dd.business_day_flag='Y'
